# ✨ Feature Request — SecureGen

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to SecureGen!  
Please fill out the sections below to help evaluate and design the feature.

## 💡 Feature Description

Clearly describe:

- What feature you would like to see
- What problem it solves
- Why it would be useful for SecureGen users

## 🧩 Context

This request relates to:

- [ ] `Get-PassWord`

- [ ] Documentation

- [ ] Scripts / tooling
- [ ] Other (please specify):

```powershell
# Example

```

- Does it improve security, UX, automation, compatibility, etc.?

Have you tried other approaches?
